ops.title: Compute cross-provider stack pruning with one indexed edge traversal
ops.description: Owner /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Source #574 crossing repeatedly visits all edges until fixed point and linearly checks native parents. Reverseordered chain requires quadratic edge visits. No claim this explains measured host load. Next executable step: CI-only reversechain fixture proves exact visit count before fix, then replace crossing only with parent-to-children traversal preserving current reachability semantics, mixed providers, cycles and duplicate edges. Independent branch/review/CI/release/localpublic adoption and affected-case verification; do not bundle focused589 or change user-facing behavior.

ops.text: Same deterministic chain fixture proves old repeated-edge work and new single enumeration; native roots, duplicate edges, connected and disconnected cycles preserve exact membership
Independent source review and required CI pass on actual final source
Merge, publish, verify installed public bytes and affected operation; no physicalIO claim from algorithm counts alone
